catalogue.description: The forecast at completion must reconcile to actual cost plus remaining forecast.
catalogue.remediation: Reconcile the cost ledger and forecast detail; do not post the close until the identity holds.
catalogue.title: EAC equals actual cost plus ETC

catalogue.description: Variance at completion must agree with the approved budget and current EAC.
catalogue.remediation: Recalculate VAC from governed BAC and EAC.
catalogue.title: VAC equals BAC minus EAC

catalogue.description: Reported cost variance must reconcile to earned value and actual cost.
catalogue.remediation: Recalculate CV and investigate source-period or currency mismatches.
catalogue.title: Cost variance equals EV minus AC

catalogue.description: Reported schedule variance must reconcile to earned and planned value.
catalogue.remediation: Recalculate SV and verify the status date and baseline time-phasing.
catalogue.title: Schedule variance equals EV minus PV

catalogue.description: The cost performance index must be derived from the same EV and AC basis.
catalogue.remediation: Recalculate CPI; verify zero-value, currency and accounting-period handling.
catalogue.title: CPI equals EV divided by AC

catalogue.description: The schedule performance index must be derived from the same EV and PV basis.
catalogue.remediation: Recalculate SPI and verify baseline and status-period alignment.
catalogue.title: SPI equals EV divided by PV

catalogue.description: Current budget must be traceable to the baseline plus approved change.
catalogue.remediation: Locate unauthorized budget movement or missing approved change records.
catalogue.title: Current budget bridges baseline and approved change

catalogue.description: Risk-adjusted EAC should bridge the deterministic forecast, pending change and quantified risk.
catalogue.remediation: Reconcile the risk register and pending-change log to the forecast.
catalogue.title: P80 EAC includes pending change and risk exposure

catalogue.description: An in-progress activity should retain positive remaining duration.
catalogue.remediation: Correct activity status, actual finish or remaining duration in P6.
catalogue.title: In-progress activity retains remaining duration

catalogue.description: Extreme negative float often indicates broken constraints, calendars or missed contractual dates.
catalogue.remediation: Review constraints, calendars and driving relationships before accepting the schedule.
catalogue.title: Total float is within an operational review range
